protocol.task: Same-comment, same-text sentiment comparison; no rating prediction
protocol.text_policy: Original data/cleaned/test.csv bytes at retained input_row; verified by input_text_sha256. New training still uses frozen cleaned rated data.
protocol.selection: Training and model selection use train/validation only. All checkpoints fixed before test scoring.
protocol.historical_model_note: Frozen historical predictions restricted to retained test rows; older training and checkpoint-selection histories differ. Matched plain vs weighted is the direct causal control.

notes: Single seed, not proof of stable improvement.
Historical rows share identical test texts but earlier training histories differ.
Ratings affect only new weighted training loss; no score prediction.
No new cause model or cause labels were trained or changed.
